problem.text: Anh read a book. On the first day she read $n$ pages in $t$ minutes, where $n$ and $t$ are positive integers. On the second day Anh read $n+1$ pages in $t+1$ minutes. Each day thereafter Anh read one more page than she read on the previous day, and it took her one more minute than on the previous day until she completely read the $374$ page book. It took her a total of $319$ minutes to read the book. Find $n+t$.

steps.title: Where to start: count the days and add two arithmetic sequences
steps.body: The daily pages $n, n+1, n+2, \ldots$ and the daily minutes $t, t+1, t+2, \ldots$ both go up by $1$ each day, and they run for the same number of days. So call the number of days $x$ and write each total as the sum of an arithmetic sequence. The sum of an arithmetic sequence is (number of terms) times (first term plus last term), divided by $2$.

your_turn.prompt: Write the total number of pages, $n + (n+1) + \cdots + (n + x - 1)$, as a formula and set it equal to $374$.
your_turn.answer: $\dfrac{x(2n + x - 1)}{2} = 374$, since there are $x$ terms, the first is $n$ and the last is $n + x - 1$.

steps.title: The number of days divides both totals
steps.body:
In the same way the minutes give $\frac{x(2t + x - 1)}{2} = 319$. Clearing the $2$:
$$x(2n + x - 1) = 748, \qquad x(2t + x - 1) = 638.$$
The brackets are integers, so $x$ divides both $748$ and $638$, and therefore $x$ divides their greatest common divisor.

your_turn.prompt: Find $\gcd(748, 638)$ and list the possible values of $x$.
your_turn.answer: $748 = 2^2\cdot 11\cdot 17$ and $638 = 2\cdot 11\cdot 29$, so the GCD is $22$ and $x$ is $1$, $2$, $11$ or $22$.

steps.title: Rule out the wrong numbers of days
steps.body: $x = 1$ is out because Anh read on a second day. For $x = 2$ the page equation says $2(2n + 1) = 748$, so $2n + 1 = 374$, but $2n + 1$ is odd and $374$ is even. That leaves $x = 11$ and $x = 22$.

your_turn.prompt: Test $x = 22$ in the page equation $x(2n + x - 1) = 748$.
your_turn.answer: $22(2n + 21) = 748$ gives $2n + 21 = 34$, so $n = 6.5$, not an integer. So $x = 22$ fails.

steps.title: Put it together
steps.body: So Anh read for $x = 11$ days. The page equation gives $11(2n + 10) = 748$, so $2n + 10 = 68$ and $n = 29$. The minute equation gives $11(2t + 10) = 638$, so $2t + 10 = 58$ and $t = 24$. Then $n + t = 29 + 24 = 53$. The answer is **$53$**.
